name: manual_5eebf9
claim: When a plan cites an internal authority doc (e.g. SECURITY.md §N) as justification for a design decision, verify the citation exists as written before trusting it — search the target file, all branches, and git history for the exact phrase, not just the section number

decisions.notes: orama-system G7 SSE plan cited 'SECURITY.md Immediate TODO §C (unauthenticated notification blocking)' as an external security mandate; the actual §C content covers spawn-agent auth/token-leakage/LAN-bind, nothing about notifications. The phrase only ever existed as this same citation and as the workstream's own open TODO checklist item — a circular self-citation laundered as external authority, not a wrong section number pointing at real content elsewhere. Confirmed via full-repo + all-branch + git-log -S search before concluding it was fabricated rather than misquoted.
